classification: Exploratory source-target and sensitivity record; not E2 acceptance or field validation
objective: Reproduce Dash-8 nearfield morphology, cloud/core structure counts and cloud envelopes while resolving standard k-epsilon instability. More cloud counts alone is insufficient.

reference_inputs.opening_status: Inferred rectangle with streamwise long axis; actual exit area and profile are unpublished.
reference_inputs.history_use: Digitized scalar provisionally applied as area mean; mean/maximum naming ambiguity is retained.
reference_inputs.turbulence: Standard k-epsilon RANS; 5% intensity and 5 cm length scales are assumed.

horizons.no_extrapolation: Figure 4 inputs support 0–5 s. A run beyond 5 s requires a separately declared tail or shutdown assumption; later count traces remain source data.

targets.bound_status: correlated rasterread allowances, not author uncertainty or statisticalconfidence
targets.missing_reads: leave blank; nearzero rawordinates retained with nonnegative physicalintervals, not fabricatedzero/extrapolation
targets.figure5_limits: cyan-color2D proxy only; no calibratedcamera/physicalscale or extractedredcore target

comparison_rules.sampling: Count each saved 0.1 s state; report exact sample time and coverage of the full 0–5 s target window.
comparison_rules.count_method: Native face connectivity and minimum one cell primary; point connectivity and minimum two cells as sensitivities. Retain all mass independently.
comparison_rules.source_bounds_compatibility: Report the fraction within horizontal and vertical raster-read bounds separately for each threshold; descriptive 0.80 fraction target and 0.90 stretch. This is never stand-alone completion or gate evidence. Propagate time bounds through the native trace on steep slopes.
comparison_rules.distance_metrics: Also report per-time count differences and relative errors where source counts are positively resolved; near zero use absolute intervals only.
comparison_rules.curve_registration: Report fixed source-center and physical-edge hypotheses; no fitted shifts.
comparison_rules.normalization: Lc=sqrt(assumed area) is conditional; published numerical exit area is unavailable.
comparison_rules.velocity_statistics: Report attached versus detached structures and number- versus mass-mean velocities; author selection and weighting are unknown. Preserve signed velocity labels separately from downward penetration Z.
comparison_rules.visuals: Computed fields with fixed scales, camera and thresholds; inferred subgrid foam cannot stand in for computed fragmentation.
comparison_rules.completion: Requested 80–90% closeness remains unproven until counts and morphology broadly agree, sustained turbulence remains stable and results withstand mesh/detector sensitivities. A partial horizon or one favorable count is insufficient.

single_factor_trials.factor: custom time-varying uneven outflow velocity forcing
single_factor_trials.change: Apply a frozen custom 24-mode seeded cosine field (seed 29, maximum centered deviation 0.60, nominal tau 0.03 s; streamwise wavelengths 0.48-0.96 m and cross-track wavelengths 0.45-0.90 m) while preserving the uniform digitized mean-history flux over the assumed 1.332 m2 opening. Corrected air backflow, mesh, standard k-epsilon, k/epsilon history tables, and PBiCGStab/DILU remain the matched reference. This custom spectrum differs from both the stationary parabolic maximum-profile trial and the previous 35% long-wave/tau=0.18 s case. The imposed velocity field is a strong provisional forcing, not measured turbulence or an observed outlet profile.
single_factor_trials.diagnostic: Runtime area-mean/min/max source speed and momentum-flux logs; native alphaPhi water ledger; alpha>=0.001 cloud and alpha>=0.9 core counts with component masses/source attachment; near-source/far-air native nut/k/epsilon; fixed-scale computed fields. The prelaunch face-quadrature checks area-mean speed to 2.3e-16 relative error, confirms nonnegative [0.4,1.6] face multipliers and >=6 source-face spacings per shortest wavelength, and predicts 5.47% more normal momentum impulse than uniform (half-maxDeltaT vs maxDeltaT difference 1.7e-8 relative). Local peak is predicted at 7.503 m/s versus maximum digitized area-mean 4.693 m/s. These are input predictions, not CFD results; transported alphaPhi flux remains measured separately.
single_factor_trials.status: queued after maximum-profile trial; diagnostic only; no E2 gate decision

This is a model ablation, not the STAR paper interface-damping method or calibrated physics.

No numerical tolerance or acceptance gate is set.

numerical_sensitivity: Refine source and plume separately; further levels are needed if counts or envelopes change materially. One cell count cannot establish convergence.
stop_conditions: Each run declares wall and memory budgets. Preserve fatal, nonfinite and unstable attempts. Healthy completion alone does not establish physical correctness.
